about: Shared test vectors for the Verify-row `cmd:` command marker (#1805, #1808). Every executor that lifts a Verify command must agree on which command a cell's marker names: statusgen (verifyCommand / markedCommands) and tools/desk (internal/verifycmd, used by verifyloop and deskrebaseline) both run this table. `marked` is the command the FIRST honoured marker names, or null when the cell carries no honoured marker (the executor then falls back to its legacy lift).

vectors.name: mention-led prose
vectors.cell: In `PublicRepoGate` change the check, then `cmd: cd tools/desk && go test ./internal/deskkit/ -count=1`; restore
